title: Kwality Pharmaceuticals Ltd - 539997 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Kwality Pharma FY26 revenue rose ~36% to INR503 crore and PAT 69% to INR67 crore; FY27 guidance INR650 crore revenue and INR100 crore PAT reiterated.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 revenue grew 35.8% YoY to INR157.1 crore, with PAT of about INR25 crore. For FY26, EBITDA margin expanded from 22% to 24% and PAT margin from 10.8% to 13.4%. The cash conversion cycle improved from 208 to 170 days after Middle East payment delays of INR60-70 crore, of which about 40% had been realised by the call. Management reiterated FY27 guidance of INR650 crore revenue and INR100 crore PAT, and set FY29 target of INR1,000 crore revenue, with FY28 at INR800-850 crore.

financial_highlights.change: vs INR370 crore in FY25, ~36% growth
earlier years cited 55% to 48-49%; Q4 gross margin cited ~44.8% by analyst

segments.name: Oncology
segments.commentary: FY26 oncology revenue about INR100-120 crore (close to 20-25% of sales); projected INR150 crore in FY27 and up to INR300 crore by FY29. Peptide oncology EBITDA ~40%, routine oncology ~25%, blended ~30-32%.

segments.name: Unregulated/semi-regulated (legacy peptide, emulsion, liposome)
segments.commentary: Roughly 35% of FY26 sales, INR150-160 crore; expected to rise to INR200-250 crore in FY27-FY28 and ~25% of FY29 revenue.

segments.name: Domestic India
segments.commentary: Peptide-based products only, ~INR40-50 crore in FY26; management expects only 10-15% growth as no own marketing is done. About 5% of FY26 exports cited from India.

segments.name: Export regional mix (FY26)
segments.commentary: MENA 20%, GCC incl. Iraq/Kurdistan 25%, LATAM 30% (Mexico+Colombia 65-70% of LATAM), Southeast Asia 10-15%.

guidance_outlook: FY27: revenue INR650 crore (management sees INR650-700 crore) and PAT INR100 crore; upside from registrations in LatAm and high-regulated markets.
FY28: revenue INR800-850 crore at ~28% EBITDA margin; FY29: INR1,000 crore revenue at ~30% EBITDA margin. INR650 crore at 26-27% EBITDA margin.
FY29 INR1,000 crore excludes hormone and biosimilar revenue; management sees INR200 crore from these by FY29 as additional.
FY27 gross margin guided at 52-53% (vs 49% in FY26) as regulated sales start from Q2 FY27.
Quarterly FY27 path: Q1 INR150-160 crore, Q2 INR160-170 crore, Q4 above INR200 crore; ~15-20% QoQ growth.
Annual interest cost to stay ~INR11 crore; working capital not expected to rise materially; debtor days target 150-160.
capex_capacity: Oncology capacity utilisation rose from 30-35% to ~65% due to EU Annexure 1 changeover and validation timelines; ~INR50 crore expansion adding a line with three lyophilizers, fully automated.

Hormone Unit 6: ~INR65 crore capex, ~50% spent in FY26; target WHO GMP before November and commercialisation in ROW markets; target INR150 crore from unregulated/semi-regulated markets before FY29. Building for oncology and hormone complete.

Four projects (hormones, oncology expansion, biosimilars with clinical trials, R&D/BE): total INR260-270 crore, of which INR46 crore spent in FY26; INR90 crore planned in FY27 and INR90-100 crore in FY28.
Capex to be funded from operating cash flows in July-October; machinery payments 30-40% already made; 4-5 months to complete.
R&D: in-house R&D budget INR5-6 crore per year; outsourced R&D INR13-14 crore; clinical trials INR60-70 crore next year. R&D target 5-6% of revenue (from ~2%).
demand_pricing: Four registrations in Germany (high-regulated) expected in roughly the next two months; 3-4 of these could come in May as ministry queries were answered. Seven-eight regulated registrations expected by end CY2027, with ~40% EBITDA margins on fresh registrations.

LatAm: 55 submissions in FY26, ~10 approvals so far, ~6 more expected in Q1-Q2 FY27, all 55 targeted by end CY2027; 25-30 more submissions planned in FY27. LatAm to contribute ~30% of FY29 revenue, Algeria 15-16%, French West Africa ~10%, GCC 10-15%, Russia 5-7%.
Middle East: Algeria sales INR80-90 crore in FY26 and INR25-30 crore in Q4; GCC margins 20-25% and management plans to replace some GCC sales with bioequivalence products at 30-35% margins.
Raw materials: ~85% sourced in India, 15% from China; API prices not up much; rupee/dollar and euro movements offset cost increases; no plan to pass costs on currently.
Debtor days fell to ~170 (from 140-150 cited by analyst in one answer); MENA receivable exposure came from government tender supplies on 100% credit.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY27 guidance of INR650 crore conservative given Q4 annualises to that level?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is somewhat conservative; true range INR650-700 crore, with potential upside of ~INR50 crore on faster LatAm and regulatory registrations.

qa_highlights.question: Oncology FY26 revenue, margins and FY29 trajectory?
qa_highlights.answer: FY26 oncology ~INR100 crore; FY27 INR150 crore and FY29 up to INR300 crore. Blended oncology EBITDA 30-32% (peptides ~40%, routine ~25%).

qa_highlights.question: How will margins expand from 27% to 30%?
qa_highlights.answer: Driven by fresh regulated registrations at ~40% EBITDA, oncology mix, and bioequivalence products; margins on new off-patent products expected 40-45% initially, falling to 25-30% by FY28-29.

qa_highlights.question: Working capital and receivables recovery?
qa_highlights.answer: INR60-70 crore stuck for 1.5-2 quarters; ~40% recovered by call, full recovery expected June-July. Management expects strong operating cash flow in Q2 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Gross margin decline in Q4 and FY27 outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Gross margin guided to 52-53% from Q2 FY27 as regulated sales come in; Q4 dip attributed partly to war-related cost increases.

qa_highlights.question: Auditor change and biosimilar partnering?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said KPMG is being closed as new auditor, with announcement expected in the next one to two quarters; biosimilar R&D to be partly funded by an Algerian partner (Hikma named as R&D import partner), with clinical cost INR110-120 crore for three MABs.

risks_watch: Receivables: Middle East/Strait of Hormuz disruption extended payment cycles; INR60-70 crore stuck, ~40% recovered; watch full recovery by June-July and Q2 FY27 operating cash flow.
Registration timing: LatAm and German approvals depend on ministry queries; FY27 revenue upside/downside hinges on this.
Gross margin: 44.8% in Q4 per analyst versus 52-53% guided for FY27; raw material and dollar/euro dynamics.
Capex funding: INR90 crore in FY27 and INR90-100 crore in FY28 to be funded from operations; hormone Unit 6 WHO GMP target before November.

Biosimilar pipeline: EPO submission in Q4 FY27 across ~50 countries; Erythropoietin registration timing uncertain; Alteplase dropped and replaced by Pembrolizumab; biosimilar revenue excluded from INR1,000 crore target.
Management did not give current cash balance on call; to be followed up.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on growth and margin targets, repeatedly calling the INR650 crore FY27 number achievable and conservative. Noticeably more cautious on receivables and cash, attributing delays to Strait of Hormuz disruption and giving approximate figures; some answers were loose or corrected in follow-ups.
key_quotes: So, we believe that INR650 crores is a very, very achievable number, but this number could increase considering if we get more registrations or queries from the ministry and the registration happens in the timely manner.
So, the mix of peptide products in the overall oncology products will be 40%.
Kwality does in-house R&D only on the oncology, general items, cephalosporin, beta-lactam, and upcoming hormone products.
So, probably the Q1 for FY27 will be the same as Q4 of FY26.

growth.why: FY27 guidance of INR650 crore revenue (up to INR650-700 crore) and INR100 crore PAT is held, implying ~29% growth over FY26's INR503 crore; backing is partial, with oncology utilisation at ~65%, a ~INR50 crore line, 10+ regulated registrations and LatAm approvals, but no firm order book covering the full guide.
